information.name: revolut-payments-import
information.description: Automatically records incoming Revolut Business bank payments into UCRM via signed webhooks, matching clients by the sender's IBAN.
information.author: Rosen Velikov

configuration.label: Revolut ClientID
configuration.description: The ClientID issued by Revolut after you upload the API certificate.

configuration.label: OAuth redirect URI
configuration.description: Set this to the plugin's Public URL (the public.php link shown above) and register the SAME value with the certificate in Revolut. The authorization code is then captured automatically — no manual copy. Its domain becomes the JWT 'iss'.

configuration.label: Authorization code (one-time)
configuration.description: Paste the 'code' value from the redirect URL after authorizing access in Revolut Business. Used once to obtain tokens, then cleared.

configuration.label: UCRM payment method name
configuration.description: Name of the UCRM payment method to use for imported payments.
